Open enrollment for 2027 ACA coverage in South Carolina runs November 1, 2026 to January 15, 2027 on HealthCare.gov. Honorbrook Insurance is an independent agency licensed in South Carolina that compares plans and checks your premium tax credit at no cost to you.

Schedule a health insurance review

Booking opens Luay’s page on PlanEnroll. Create your profile there and ask for your meeting. Having these ready makes the first conversation useful:

  • Your ZIP code and who needs coverage.
  • Your expected household income for the year.
  • The doctors and prescriptions you want covered.
  • Your coverage today and the date it ends, if it is ending.

When PlanEnroll asks what type of meeting you would like, choose Health. You may be asked to complete a short Scope of Appointment form first. It does not obligate you to enroll. The first open time is at least 24 hours ahead. To talk sooner, call (301) 615-8289 or text (571) 354-0146.

Help with the cost of coverage in South Carolina

Premium tax credits lower your monthly Marketplace premium based on your household income and the cost of local plans. The enhanced federal credits that applied through 2025 have expired, so many households pay more than before. To know your number, run it with your real income. Our subsidy guide explains what happens if your income changes during the year.

Medicaid in South Carolina

South Carolina has not expanded Medicaid. Parents and caretaker relatives can qualify at or below 62% of the federal poverty level, and the state lists no income limit for adults without children, who generally do not qualify. Whether you qualify depends on your household and income, so we check Medicaid and Marketplace eligibility together before you pick a plan.

Plan choices and networks in South Carolina

Marketplace plans come in bronze, silver, gold and platinum levels, and networks differ by insurer and by where you live. Compare the metal tiers, check that your doctors and hospitals are in network, and look at the deductible and out-of-pocket maximum, not just the premium.

Business owners and self-employed in South Carolina

If you run a business, you may have better options than the individual Marketplace. See ICHRA (an employer allowance for employees’ individual plans), group health and SHOP, and self-employed health insurance.

Common questions

South Carolina ACA FAQ

When is ACA open enrollment in South Carolina?
Open enrollment for 2027 coverage in South Carolina runs from November 1, 2026 to January 15, 2027, according to HealthCare.gov. Dates can change, so confirm on the Marketplace site before you plan around them.
Did the enhanced ACA tax credits end?
The enhanced federal premium tax credits expired at the end of 2025 and have not been extended. Your subsidy depends on your income and the plans available where you live, so we check it for you.
Can I get help choosing an ACA plan in South Carolina?
Yes. We are an independent agency licensed in South Carolina. We compare plans, check your premium tax credit and Medicaid eligibility, and help you enroll by phone or video. Our help is free to you.
What if I miss open enrollment?
A qualifying life event, such as losing job-based coverage, moving or a change in household, can open a Special Enrollment Period. See our guide to losing health coverage or call us.
